title: CDC - Preventing Chronic Disease:For Authors
content: Author’s Corner Print Minus Related Pages This section presents information on how to organize and submit manuscripts to Preventing Chronic Disease . Please read all portions of this section before submitting your manuscript. General information : provides information on the journal’s publishing schedule, fees and charges, copyright, and the editorial review process. Types of articles : describes each type of article the journal publishes, including essays, original research reports, book reviews, and announcements. This page includes format information on references and word count. Manuscript requirements : provides details on manuscript format (eg, font size, table and figure requirements, verb tense, permissions). How to submit a manuscript : outlines the initial steps of submitting a manuscript to ScholarOne Manuscripts. Publication Cover : If you are a published PCD author, you may add this PDF page as a cover for your published manuscript. Customize the cover by adding your article’s title to the text field and save for printing and digital sharing of your article. Download Cover . [PDF – 94 KB] The opinions expressed by authors contributing to this journal do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, the Public Health Service, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or the authors’ affiliated institutions. Last Reviewed: September 15, 2022 Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
